name: Ruins Investigation
description: Delve into the ancient structures of Makara. Every corridor holds secrets and threats alike.

dialog.speaker: Scavenger
dialog.text: Found some kind of weapon a few rooms back. Doesn't use any ammo I've ever seen. It just... glows.

dialog.speaker: Scavenger
dialog.text: My partner went deeper in yesterday and hasn't come back. I'm starting to think I should stop waiting.
